hero.name: Indian Painting Gateway
hero.tagline: Paint any prompt as a Kangra or Mughal miniature: two FLUX.1-dev LoRAs on fal.ai behind one open API on AWS in Mumbai, with a daily image limit.
hero.label: Indian Painting Gateway: paint any prompt as a Kangra or Mughal miniature through one open API, with two FLUX.1-dev LoRAs on fal.ai

cards.label: What the gateway does: two styles, two calls, an open API, a daily limit, no GPU to run and one deploy script

items.title: Kangra or Mughal
items.body: Two FLUX.1-dev LoRAs, one per style. A prompt that leaves out its style gets the style's phrase added.

items.title: Start, then collect
items.body: POST / returns a call_id at once. GET /result/{call_id} answers 202 until the image itself comes back.

items.title: No key, any origin
items.body: Like the Modal app it replaces, it needs no API key and answers pages served from anywhere.

items.title: A ceiling on spending
items.body: One DynamoDB counter allows a set number of images each IST day, then answers 429 until midnight.

items.title: No GPU to run
items.body: fal runs FLUX.1-dev on its own GPUs and bills per image. The Lambda does no image work itself.

items.title: One script
items.body: deploy.ps1 zips the code, deploys the CloudFormation stack and publishes the API stage.
